title: grammar.span_removed
description: Removes a manual grammar highlight (reversible tombstone). OPS.md#grammarspan_removed

sentence_id.description: Soft reference to sentence.id; never validated.

grammar_point_id.description: Grammar point; must exist (may be tombstoned).

start_offset.description: UTF-16 code-unit offset into sentence.text, inclusive.

end_offset.description: Exclusive end; must be > start_offset (server rejects otherwise). entity_id = '<sentence_id>|<grammar_point_id>|<start_offset>|<end_offset>|manual'.
